verdict.rationale: Signifyd's ReadMe-hosted API reference has a 'Try It!' panel on endpoint pages, so examples can be run interactively, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec backs it. Running requests needs real per-team API credentials, a safe test team is not self-serve because it requires contacting support, and some Enterprise API docs are gated behind the app login. missing for 10: credential-free or sandboxed runnable examples, ungated access to the full reference, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the Try It panel works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Click Try It! to start a request and see the response here
Auth is HTTP Basic with a per-team API key, so execution needs real credentials.
Signifyd publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document
